description: TanStack Query hooks for transfers, receiving, adjustments, and low stock alerts - following existing hook patterns in src/hooks/
steps: Create src/hooks/useTransfers.ts: useTransfers(filters) - list transfers with status/warehouse/date filters joining stock_transfer_items and warehouse names. useTransfer(id) - single transfer with items expanded. useCreateTransfer() mutation - calls initiateTransfer service. useApproveTransfer() mutation. useRejectTransfer() mutation. useCompleteTransfer() mutation - invalidates stock_movements, inventory, transfers queries on success. Follow exact pattern from useStockMovements.ts and usePurchaseOrders.ts (useQuery with queryKey arrays, useMutation with onSuccess invalidation).

Create src/hooks/useReceiving.ts: usePendingPOs() - queries purchase_orders where status IN ('confirmed', 'partially_received') with items and supplier name. useReceiveItems() mutation - calls receiving service, invalidates purchase_orders + stock_movements + inventory queries. useGRNs(poId?) - list GRNs optionally filtered by PO. useGRN(id) - single GRN with items joined to products.

Create src/hooks/useAdjustments.ts: useAdjustmentReasons() - queries stock_adjustment_reasons where is_active=true. useCreateAdjustment() mutation - calls adjustments service, invalidates stock_movements + inventory. useAdjustmentHistory(filters) - paginated history with reason/warehouse/product/date filters joining products and warehouses for names.

Create src/hooks/useLowStock.ts: useLowStockProducts() - queries inventory joined with products where quantity < reorder_point, returns product info + current qty + reorder_point + min_stock_level. useLowStockAlerts() - queries notifications where type='warning' and title contains 'Low Stock'. useDismissAlert() mutation - marks notification as read, invalidates notifications query.
acceptance_criteria: All four hook files exist with properly typed exports
Each hook follows TanStack Query patterns: useQuery with queryKey, useMutation with mutationFn + onSuccess invalidation
Proper TypeScript types on all return values and parameters
bun run type-check passes with zero errors
